relevance_note: Case report of a GFAP variant carrier with tentative Alexander disease and affected-sign relatives: 'We found a GFAP mutation (c.382G > A, p.Asp128Asn) in a 68-year-old man'.
method_note: Read the paper in full and built the JSON with a short script (values typed by hand from my reading; no table transcription). Proband labelled by his pedigree label 'II.1' ('subject II.1 in Fig. 1b'); 'proband' is a role word. Relatives II.3, III.2 and III.5 are the p.Asp128Asn carriers named in the text; other family members (including those who tested negative) appear only in the pedigree figure (Fig. 1b) and get no rows; their sex and relationship to the proband are not stated in text. The relatives' finding 'without evidence of neurological symptoms' is recorded as an excluded feature; it was not used to exclude specific checklist items (left not reported) because they do show pyramidal signs. Two previously reported p.Asp128Asn cases cited jointly as [32, 33] are included under the v4 passing-mention rule because the variant is given; the citation cannot be split per person, and 'Rosenthal fibers ... observed posthumously in one of the cases' cannot be assigned to either, so vital status was left not reported for both; 'seem to be of the same classification' (adult/type II) is hedged and not recorded. Inheritance not reported: the paper says only that family sequencing 'suggested Mendelian inheritance' without naming a carrier parent; no parental testing statement. Relatives' variant rows carry only the protein string printed for them; zygosity, type, functional evidence and pathogenicity are stated for the proband's allele and were not copied to relatives (v5 rule). No transcript printed for the patient variant (NP_002046 is a protein accession for the alignment figure; BC013596 is the expression clone). Age 68 recorded both as age at last evaluation (presentation) and as age at diagnosis (abstract: GFAP mutation found in a 68-year-old man). Palatal myoclonus absence was mapped to checklist 'palatal tremor' excluded, and absence of 'abnormal mental or emotional status' to 'cognitive decline' excluded (broader absence). The negative etiological workup is recorded as one excluded row written as the paper names it (D-27). n_patients_reported left null: the authors state no count. No contradictions found. Variants p.Arg79Cys, p.Arg79His, p.Arg239Cys, p.Arg239His, p.Asp157Asn and others are discussed only as constructs or literature examples without individuals, so no rows.
